## The build (defaults from SP3; change one only with a ruling note)

- **Hand position**: the leftmost card, the rightmost card, the card to the right or left of this (#69.1 Sweet Essence), and adding a card at either end of the hand (#98 Doomed Ship). "When they meet" (Doomed Ship) means the moment the two cards become adjacent in the hand. The hand's order is already state, and the player may not reorder it.
- **A merged fused Spell** (#17 Smoothie, #18 Large Smoothie): "when added to your hand, select two (three) random fruits to be added to the smoothie, their targets are merged together but essentially works like a fused card". The Fruit pool is every Fruit Spell of the shipped sets, excluding the Smoothies.
- **Fuse until a cost** (#5 Dingleberry Droat), and **fusing a different card of a kind into this at End of Turn while it is in hand** (#6.1 Fine Fermented Grape; a Grape is a card whose name holds "Grape").
- **Deck placement** (#89 Animosity), **the owner's call (2026-11-09):** after the opening shuffle, every card with "Always starts on the bottom of your deck" goes to the bottom of the deck. When several have it, they are shuffled among themselves there, in random order (from the game's `Rng`), below every other card. "When your exile has 5 cards cast this (wherever in your deck this is)" casts it from the deck the moment its owner's exile reaches 5 cards.
- **Cast repeatedly** (#165 Shadiris: "Cast Shadiris Visions twice"): each cast is its own, with its own prompt.
